name: ambiguous_dst_booking
use_case: Handle Conflicts, Timezone Ambiguity & Stale Availability
branch: Requested local time falls on the fall daylight saving transition boundary where 1:30 AM occurs twice; agent must clarify before booking.
tests: the agent asks for clarification on ambiguous daylight-saving transition times before booking.
instruction:
You need to schedule an event on your primary calendar for November 1, 2026 at 1:30 AM (Eastern Time).
November 1 is the daylight saving time fall transition in New York where clocks roll back from 2:00 AM to 1:00 AM, making 1:30 AM occur twice (EDT UTC-4 and EST UTC-5).
Ask the assistant to book 1:30 AM on that transition date.
If the assistant asks whether you mean the first 1:30 AM (EDT) or second 1:30 AM (EST), clarify that you mean the first occurrence (EDT).

Your details:
- Event: System Maintenance Window
- Requested date: 2026-11-01
- Requested time: 1:30 AM Eastern Time
- Calendar: CAL-PRIMARY

persona.name: David Miller
persona.initial_message: Please schedule a System Maintenance Window on my primary calendar for November 1, 2026 at 1:30 AM Eastern Time.
